description: Defines a global exception handling component for a Spring Boot backend application. It intercepts various exceptions during request processing and converts them into JSON API error responses to ensure consistent error formatting.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A REST controller advice class that handles and converts various exceptions into standardized API error responses.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation errors thrown when method arguments are invalid, compiling field errors into a detailed response.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles EntityNotFoundException, returning a 404 Not Found response with error details.

methods.name: handleBadRequest
methods.description: Handles IllegalArgumentException, returning a 400 Bad Request response.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions, returning a 500 Internal Server Error with a generic message.
